title: Smart Factory IoT Security Engineer
description:
Our solutions are a key part of most industries \- electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more. Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations.
   

  

**Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.**
**Your role**
 As Smart Factory Security Engineer, you own the security of every solution onboarded into VTBA's Smart Factory and Industry 4\.0 landscape. You act as the security gatekeeper and technical authority for new OT/IIoT systems, connected production equipment, and digital manufacturing solutions from the moment they are evaluated until they are fully integrated and running in production. You embed security by design into every onboarding: assessing risk, defining and enforcing hardening and segmentation requirements, validating secure architectures, and ensuring new systems comply with IEC 62443, NIS2, and internal security policy before and after go\-live. You maintain an up\-to\-date OT/IIoT security posture and asset inventory (CMDB), act as the first point of contact for the business on security matters, and ensure that production processes are never compromised by unsecured or unmanaged systems.You support M\&A and integration due diligence from a security standpoint, securing previously unregistered or newly acquired systems, and you collaborate closely with IT, network, production, and external integration partners to guarantee a seamless and secure Industry 4\.0 rollout. In case of a security incident or outage tied to onboarded solutions, you drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures.
   

  

* Develop the Smart Factory cybersecurity strategy aligned with business and security objectives.
* Design secure architectures for manufacturing systems, Industrial IoT (IIoT), MES, and OT networks
* Own the security review and validation of all new OT/IIoT solutions being onboarded onto Smart Factory / production networks, from design through go\-live.
* Define and enforce security\-by\-design requirements (segmentation, hardening, access control, secure remote access) for new production lines, machines, and digital solutions.
* Be the first point of contact and internal security consultant for production engineers, IT teams, and solution vendors during onboarding projects.
* Maintain a secure and stable OT/IIoT environment for VTBA, including an accurate, continuously updated OT security asset inventory (CMDB).
* Support Smart Factory projects involving IoT, AI, cloud connectivity, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing platforms.
* Define and maintain OT asset inventories, security baselines, and lifecycle management processes.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and penetration testing of industrial systems.
* Act as the security contact for external production and integration partners, reviewing and validating the security quality of their work before systems connect to company networks.
* Drive compliance with IEC 62443, NIS2, ANSSI\-aligned practices, and internal IT/OT security regulations across all onboarded solutions.
* Support M\&A and acquisition due diligence, assessing and securing newly acquired or previously unregistered OT/IIoT systems.
* Perform regular on\-call duty for security\-related escalations on onboarded solutions


**To Succeed You Will Need**
* 2\+ years' experience securing OT/IIoT or Industry 4\.0 environments
* Solid knowledge of IEC 62443 and familiarity with NIS2 and other relevant OT/ICS cybersecurity frameworks.
* Strong understanding of network segmentation, secure remote access, and hardening practices for industrial and IIoT systems.
* Customer Service Skills (interaction with end users and solution vendors).
* ITIL process knowledge.
* Understanding of reporting \& data visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI and Excel.
* Advanced troubleshooting experience in OT/IIoT environments, including security log analysis (firewall, OT Defender, machine logs).
* Analytical Skills\-able to conduct security risk assessments and analyze log files to identify vulnerabilities and operational limitations.
* Reporting Skills\-able to summarize and present periodic security reports and recommend improvements to onboarding procedures.
* Planning Skills\-able to define security requirements and roadmaps for new solutions and production facilities.
* Excellent communication skills in English\-written and verbal.
* Self\-organized and persistent in a polite way to obtain missing information from colleagues, business, and vendors.
* Willing to undertake national and international business travel to support the secure rollout of new OT/IIoT solutions.


**In return, we offer you**
 We offer you a modern and flexible work in a company that manufactures state\-of\-the\-art and innovative vacuum products and systems. You will be part of a young and international team and will have the opportunity to support the latest technologies. This guarantees training and enables you to develop further. We work in flat structures and all IT colleagues are in direct contact with the internal customers to understand their technical needs and support them in technology. Thus, in addition to the technical network knowledge, you will also gain a deep insight into the internal processes and projects of our company.
   

  

**Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice**
 Bright ideas come from all of us. The more unique perspectives we embrace, the more innovative we are. Together we build a culture where difference is valued and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.

title: Lead OT Cybersecurity Solutions Architect
description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full\-service integrated technology
   

  

 consultancy and professional services to the built environment.
   

  





  

  

 We partner with some of the largest organisations globally, supporting our clients to improve asset performance and security, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As Lead OT Cybersecurity Solutions Architect, you are FPC Digital’s global technical authority, blending strategy with hands\-on delivery in a high\-profile hybrid role, reporting into the Managing Director with a dotted line into the CTO (Matrix Structure)..
   

  





 In an era where intelligent buildings and data centres lack traditional "air\-gaps," you will design resilient, secure\-by\-design architectures. Your mission includes defining next\-gen OT security services and executing the strategy for our Centre of Excellence (CoE) based OT SOC.
   

  





 Operating across consulting and delivery, you will embed cybersecurity into foundational BMS and Smart Building processes from design through operations.
   

  





 Integrated into the global Technology \& Innovation function, you will lead the Cybersecurity SteerCo within the Technical Design Authority (TDA). Reporting technically to the CTO, you ensure field insights directly shape global standards, partner strategies, and innovation.
   

  





 Though technically focused with no direct reports, you are central to FPC’s people strategy, mentoring a specialised OT Cybersecurity team. You will also enhance auditing benchmarks and provide technical governance across all global deliverables.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 The responsibilities for the Lead OT Cybersecurity Solutions Architect include, but are not limited to, the following key areas:
   

  





  

  





 Technical Design, Smart Building Integration \& Delivery
   

  





  

  





 Secure\-by\-Design Architectures: Define, design and execute end\-to\-end technical security architectures for complex OT, BMS (Building Management Systems), and IoT ecosystems across global Corporate Real Estate and Hyperscale Data Centres.
   

  




* BMS \& Smart Building Design Lens: Embed a robust cybersecurity perspective into the physical and logical design of Building Management Systems and Smart Building infrastructure, championing security as a primary design criterion.
* Cross\-Functional Synergy: Collaborate across all consulting and delivery facets of FPC Digital, aligning strategic advice with practical field engineering and commissioning.
* Standards Enforcement: Champion the application of global security standards, such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82, and CIS Controls, translating theoretical compliance into practical, robust engineering implementations.
* Zero Trust \& Segmentation: Design and deploy modern network micro\-segmentation, identity and access management (IAM), and zero\-trust policies tailored specifically for fragile, legacy, and modern OT systems.



  

  





 Technical Design Authority (TDA) \& Innovation Leadership
   

  




* Vertical Ownership: Lead the dedicated Cybersecurity SteerCo within FPC’s Technical Design Authority (TDA), serving as the principal expert voice and collaborating directly with the CTO's office on cybersecurity aspects in respect of global technical direction. Attend other TDA SteerCos to provide subject matter expertise on Cybersecurity aspects (namely, Innovation, IT and Technical Architecture SteerCos).
* Cybersecurity SteerCo Chair: Chair and lead the Cybersecurity SteerCo, coordinating with Subject Matter Experts across multiple engineering, software, and operational facets to lead on cybersecurity matters, coordinating with other SteerCos and for cross\-disciplinary support and innovation.
* Lab Environment \- Agnostic Sandbox Curation: Empowered with the technical freedom to curate, test, and evaluate emerging next\-generation security tools within FPC’s Digital Lab environment. This ensures FPC maintains its strict technology\-agnostic position, allowing you to design robust integration playbooks that combine the best tools on the market for our clients' benefit.
* Expert\-Driven Business Value: Ensure that our hands\-on subject matter experts are the primary catalysts driving our business innovation, translating deep domain expertise into scalable, commercial offerings that benefit our global clients and FPC's business growth.



  

  





 Auditing, Benchmarking \& Technical Governance
   

  




* Leveling Up the Auditing Standard: Build upon FPC's highly successful track record of over 500 completed building audits to elevate our existing methodologies into a specialized, next\-generation OT cybersecurity evaluation standard.
* Lighthouse Audits \& Framework Verification: Personally lead high\-complexity "Lighthouse" audits at flagship client sites to establish and validate FPC’s newly elevated OT security frameworks, turning complex technical findings into strategic portfolio risk narratives.
* Auditing Enablement \& Handover: Establish repeatable frameworks and playbook\-driven auditing packages, allowing you to hand over subsequent delivery phases to a trained, competent engineering team.
* Ongoing Governance \& Oversight: Provide technical governance and rigorous quality oversight of all OT cybersecurity deliverables produced by the delivery teams globally, ensuring consistency and alignment with our established benchmarks.



  

  





 Service Definition, Frameworks \& OT SOC Playbook Development
   

  




* Standardised Frameworks \& Policies: Lead the development and engineering of comprehensive OT cybersecurity frameworks, operational policies, and threat mitigation guidelines. These will be deployed directly across our clients' global portfolios, as well as serving as the standardized foundation for FPC's internal service delivery models.
* OT SOC Integration \& Playbook Design: Own the technical design, setup parameters, and operational playbooks for FPC's pioneering OT Security Operations Centre (OT SOC) based out of our Centre of Excellence (CoE). Develop specific threat detection use cases, alerting rules, and incident response playbooks for BMS/EPMS protocols (such as BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks).
* Collaborative Scaling \& Delivery: Partner directly with FPC’s Global Head of Engineering and Global Head of Operations to co\-author, test, and implement operational workflows. Ensure the OT SOC and broader OT security services are designed for rapid scalability and maximum operational efficiency.
* SLA Alignment: Architect the technical components of the services to cleanly support the delivery of enterprise\-grade Service Level Agreements (SLAs), partnering with FPC Operations who will own day\-to\-day service execution and operational metrics.
* Service Lifecycle \& Portfolio Evolution: Create, define, and launch standardized global OT Cybersecurity service offerings (e.g., threat hunting, managed detection, and secure remote access), collaborating with the Managing Director of FPC Digital and the CTO to keep FPC's commercial strategy ahead of market demands.



  

  





 Thought Leadership, Market Education \& Partner Ecosystem
   

  




* Thought Leadership \& Client Engagement: Act as FPC's foremost industry\-facing expert in the Cybersecurity domain, driving market education and thought leadership by authoring strategic insights, participating in industry event panels, and hosting exclusive, closed\-door forums for major enterprise clients to foster safe knowledge\-sharing and strategic alignment.
* Strategic Partner Ecosystem \& Co\-Innovation: Lead the identification, evaluation, and selection of next\-generation cybersecurity partners. Determine how diverse, best\-in\-class technologies (including edge connectivity, endpoint protection, and identity management platforms) work together to deliver cohesive, robust, and technology\-agnostic enterprise solutions for our global clients, while collaborating with partner engineering teams to influence their roadmaps.
* Technical Mentorship: Act as the internal technical guide for our wider digital engineering division, mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers to create a robust, technically elite OT Cybersecurity team.
* Ongoing Education: Champion continuous learning, certifying that our engineering teams stay ahead of the curve in certifications (e.g., GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Specialist).



  

  





 Innovation \& Culture
   

  




* Contribute to improving project delivery processes, tools, and frameworks
* Support lessons learned, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Encourage adoption of best practices and efficient ways of working
* Promote a collaborative and high\-performance team culture



  

  





 FPC Corporate Responsibilities
   

  




* Represent FPC professionally in all client and internal interactions
* Lead and support project teams, fostering collaboration and performance
* Adhere to company policies, governance standards, and reporting requirements
* Support continuous improvement across delivery operations


**Qualifications**

 Skills and Experience
   

  





 Essential:
   

  




* Education: Industry expertise and relevant certifications are highly valued and may substitute for formal academic qualifications.
* High\-level cybersecurity certifications: GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional), GRID (Active Industrial Threat Detection), CISSP, or certified ISA/IEC 62443 cybersecurity specialist.



 Desirable:
   

  




* Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or equivalent professional engineering designation is highly desirable.



 Industry Expertise:
   

  




* A proven track record (typically 10\+ years) in a Principal, Technical Lead, or Design Authority capacity specializing in OT Cybersecurity, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), or Smart Building Systems (BMS/EMS).
* Sector Expertise: Direct experience engineering security solutions for high\-performance spaces, specifically Hyperscale/Colocation Data Centres and Large\-Scale Corporate Real Estate portfolios.
* Standards \& Protocols: Extensive knowledge of IEC 62443, Zero Trust models, and traditional OT networking protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, KNX).
* Auditing Capability: Strong background in establishing physical and digital OT site auditing processes, compiling executive\-level and deep\-dive technical reports.



 Soft Skills:
   

  




* Influence Without Authority: The ability to influence executive\-level client stakeholders and internal delivery teams solely through technical credibility and clear strategic communication.
* The "Teacher" Mindset: A passion for coaching, guiding, and demystifying complex technical risks for others, with a desire to grow collective team capability.



 Personal Attributes
   

  




* Highly professional, with unwavering honesty and integrity.
* Exceptional communicator and client\-relationship builder.
* A continuous and agile learner.
* A systems thinker with attention to detail.
* A strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into action.


**Additional Information**

**Why Join Us?**




**At FPC Global, you’ll be part of a community—not just a company. When you join us, you’ll:**



* Work across a broad and impactful remit
* Gain exposure to multiple business functions
* Develop a strong foundation for future growth opportunities
* Be part of a collaborative, people\-first culture where your contribution truly matters
* Work on impactful projects that shape industries and redefine the built environment
* Grow your career through leadership development, cross\-functional collaboration, and exposure to cutting\-edge technologies
* Be supported and included in a culture that values diversity, balance, and teamwork
* Make a real difference, contributing to high\-performance, innovative, and iconic outcomes worldwide



**We offer a competitive salary and a benefits package tailored to your location and role, including:**



* Flexible \& hybrid working
* Private medical insurance
* Competitive salary \& discretionary annual bonus
* Ongoing professional development

title: Principal Product Security Engineer
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Product Security Engineer to drive the security posture of Candescent’s applications and services throughout the entire Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). This is a hands\-on practitioner role designed for a senior security professional with a strong foundation in software development or engineering.
   

  

 In this role, you will champion a "shift\-left" security culture, embedding core application security practices—including SAST, DAST, SCA, and secure coding standards—directly into modern CI/CD pipelines. Additionally, you will serve as the primary expert responsible for defining secure design patterns and governance for integrating third\-party artificial intelligence and large language model (LLM) services across the enterprise.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities and Deliverables
   

  

 Core Product Security \& Shift\-Left Engineering
   

  

* Shift\-Left Implementation: Partner closely with engineering teams to embed threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and automation early in the product development lifecycle.
* Pipeline Automation (SAST/DAST/SCA): Own the selection, integration, and tuning of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools within automation pipelines.
* Vulnerability Management: Analyze tool outputs, filter out false positives, and collaborate directly with developers to provide actionable, prioritized remediation guidance.
* Secure Coding \& Awareness: Define, maintain, and evangelize secure coding best practices based on OWASP Top 10 and real\-world threat vectors; conduct technical code reviews and security mentorship for engineering teams.


 Secure AI Integration \& Governance (Specialized Skill Set)
   

  

* Secure AI Architecture: Ability to define and maintain secure integration patterns for third\-party AI and LLM services, focusing on API security, authentication, secrets management, and data\-in\-transit protections.
* Data Guardrails: Ability to establish and enforce input/output controls, prompt handling standards, and data classification guardrails for AI\-enabled applications.
* Threat Mitigation: Ability to identify and mitigate AI\-specific risks including prompt injection, model manipulation, data leakage, adversarial inputs, and shadow AI adoption.
* Regulatory Compliance: Align internal AI security controls to emerging frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001\) and ensure usage satisfies financial regulations (GLBA, PCI DSS, DORA, and NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500\).


**Requirements**
 Experience \& Technical Background
   

  

* Software Engineering Foundation: Strong background as a past software developer and/or security practitioner with a verifiable track record in software engineering.
* AppSec Core: 5\-7\+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or product security.
* Hands\-on AppSec Tooling: Proven experience configuring, managing, and automating SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling inside automated enterprise deployment workflows.
* Cloud \& API Expert: Deep expertise in securing cloud\-native environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and microservices/API\-based integrations.
* AI/ML Security Exposure: Working knowledge of AI/ML enterprise consumer risks (e.g., OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) and experience securing integrations with major LLM providers.


 Security Foundations (Any of the following)
   

  

* CISSP — Certified Information Systems Security Professional
* CCSP — Certified Cloud Security Professional
* Cloud Platform Security Certification — AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, AZ\-500, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced AI Credentials: CAISP (Certified AI Security Professional), CAISS, or AIGP (Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional).


**Regulated Environment Experience:** 
 Background working within regulated financial services or a tightly controlled compliance environment

 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Information Security Analyst
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a
 **Information Security Analyst** 
 to join our ever\-evolving
 **Information Security Team** 
 and help shape the future of Global Payments.
   

  

 Summary of This Role
   

  

 Evaluates, tests, recommends, develops, coordinates, monitors, and maintains information security policies, procedures and systems, including hardware, firmware and software . Ensures that IS security architecture/designs, plans, controls, processes, standards, policies and procedures are aligned with IS standards and overall IS security . Identifies security risks and exposures, determines the causes of security violations and suggests procedures to halt future incidents. Investigates and resolves security incidents and recommends enhancements to improve security. Develops techniques and procedures for conducting IS security risk assessments and compliance audits, the evaluation and testing of hardware, firmware and software for possible impact on system security, and the investigation and resolution of security incidents.

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.
   

  

 What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.
   

  

 Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Agents whose output nobody re\-checks.** 
 You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.
   

  

**A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know.** 
 Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.
   

  

 Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.
   

  

**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi\-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.
* An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.
* Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high\-fan\-out integration reliability; multi\-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.
* 10\+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.
* Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.
* Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go\-to\-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.
* Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote\-first, most of that happens in writing.


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
